description: Employee forgot their password and cannot sign in to their Windows laptop
solution: Send the user to the self-service password reset portal. If they are not enrolled, verify their identity with the helpdesk checklist and issue a temporary password that must be changed at next login.

description: User cannot remember the password for their work account after a long holiday
solution: Reset the password from the admin console after verifying identity, force a change at next sign-in, and remind the user to update saved passwords on their phone.

description: Password reset link email never arrives
solution: Check the spam folder, confirm the alternate email and phone number registered on the account, and wait up to 10 minutes. An admin can trigger a fresh reset from the directory console if it still does not arrive.

description: Password expired while working remotely and the VPN rejects the new password
solution: Change the password through the web self-service portal or while on the office network, then reconnect the VPN and update saved credentials in Windows Credential Manager.

description: User gets a message that their password has expired when opening email
solution: Reset the password through the self-service portal, sign out of all Microsoft Office apps, and sign back in with the new password.

description: New password is rejected even though it looks strong
solution: Check the password policy: minimum length, no reuse of the last 12 passwords, and no username or common words. Try a longer passphrase of several unrelated words.

description: Account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts
solution: Unlock the account in Active Directory or the admin center. Ask the user to wait 15 to 30 minutes if auto-unlock is enabled and to remove stale saved passwords from phones and mapped drives.

description: Account keeps locking every few minutes even after being unlocked
solution: Find the lockout source in the domain controller event logs (event 4740). It is usually an old password saved on a phone, mapped drive, or scheduled task. Update the password there.

description: User returned from leave and their account is disabled
solution: Confirm the return with the manager, re-enable the account, reset the password, and connect the laptop to the network or VPN so cached credentials refresh.

description: User got a new phone and cannot receive MFA codes
solution: Verify the user's identity, clear the old MFA methods in the admin console, and have them register the authenticator app again on the new phone.

description: MFA push notifications are not arriving on the phone
solution: Check that notifications are allowed for the authenticator app, that the phone has data or Wi-Fi, and open the app manually to approve. Re-register the app if push still fails.

description: Authenticator app says the verification code is invalid
solution: The phone clock is usually out of sync. Turn on automatic date and time, use the time correction option in the authenticator app, and try the new code.

description: User lost their phone and cannot pass multi-factor authentication
solution: Revoke active sessions, remove the lost device from MFA, issue a temporary access pass, register a new device, and report the lost phone to the security team.

description: SMS verification codes arrive late or not at all
solution: Confirm the phone number on the profile is correct and switch the user to authenticator app codes or a phone call, which are more reliable than SMS.

description: Single sign-on keeps redirecting in a loop
solution: Clear cookies and cache for the identity provider domain, try a private browser window, confirm the computer clock is correct, and check conditional access policies.

description: SSO says the user is not assigned to the application
solution: Add the user or their group to the application's assignments in the identity provider and allow a few minutes for the change to apply.

description: Access to a cloud app is blocked by conditional access
solution: The device is probably not marked compliant. Check enrollment and compliance status in Intune, fix any failed compliance policy, or connect from a trusted network.

description: Employee needs access to a shared folder or business application
solution: Have the user submit an access request with manager approval. Add them to the correct security group following least privilege and confirm access once the group syncs.

description: Employee changed teams and needs different permissions
solution: Get approval from the new manager, remove groups from the old role, add groups for the new role, and document the change in the ticket.

description: New hire starts Monday and needs a laptop and accounts
solution: Use the HR onboarding ticket to create the directory and email accounts, assign licenses and groups, image a laptop, enroll it in device management, and schedule MFA setup on day one.

description: Employee is leaving the company on Friday
solution: Disable the account on the last day, revoke sessions and MFA, convert the mailbox to shared or forward it to the manager, move OneDrive files to the manager, and collect all equipment.

description: Outlook is stuck on Loading Profile and never opens
solution: Start Outlook in safe mode with outlook.exe /safe, disable add-ins, run an Office Quick Repair, and create a new mail profile from Control Panel if it still hangs.

description: Outlook crashes immediately after starting
solution: Update Office, disable recently added add-ins, run Office Online Repair, and rebuild the OST data file by renaming it so Outlook recreates it.

description: Outlook keeps asking for the password again and again
solution: Remove cached entries for Office and Outlook in Windows Credential Manager, sign out of the Office account and sign back in, and confirm modern authentication is enabled.

description: Mailbox is full and the user cannot send or receive email
solution: Empty Deleted Items and Junk, move old mail into an archive or enable Online Archive, or raise the quota after manager approval.

description: User is not receiving emails from an external sender
solution: Check the junk folder and quarantine, run a message trace in the admin center, and release the message if it is legitimate. Add the sender to the allow list if needed.

description: Emails sent to the user take hours to arrive
solution: Run a message trace to find the delay, check for inbox rules or forwarding loops, and confirm the mailbox is not near its quota. Escalate to the messaging team if the delay is on the server side.

description: Email bounces back because the attachment is too large
solution: The attachment limit is 25 MB. Upload the file to OneDrive or SharePoint and send a sharing link instead of attaching it.

description: Email is stuck in the Outbox and will not send
solution: Make sure Work Offline is turned off, check the network, remove any very large attachment, restart Outlook, and move the message out of the Outbox and resend it.

description: User cannot see the shared mailbox in Outlook
solution: Confirm the user has Full Access permission, allow up to 60 minutes for auto-mapping, or add it manually under Account Settings, More Settings, Advanced.

description: Meeting invitations are not appearing on the calendar
solution: Check the invite was not sent to Junk, confirm the user is not in offline mode, update Outlook, and verify the calendar syncs on mobile. Reset the navigation pane with outlook.exe /resetnavpane.

description: User was added to a distribution list but gets no emails
solution: Membership changes can take up to an hour. Check whether the list only accepts messages from internal senders and confirm the user is listed as a member.

description: Company logo is missing from the email signature
solution: Use the approved signature template with an embedded or hosted image, and check that the image is not blocked by the recipient's mail client.

description: User received a suspicious email asking for their password
solution: Do not click links or open attachments. Use the Report Phishing button, have the helpdesk purge the message from other mailboxes, and reset the password and run a scan if the user already clicked.

description: User clicked a link in a phishing email
solution: Disconnect from the network if malware is suspected, reset the password, revoke active sessions, check sign-in logs, run a full antivirus scan, and notify the security team.

description: User receives large amounts of spam
solution: Add repeat senders to the block list, report messages as junk, and ask the messaging team to review the spam filter thresholds for the mailbox.

description: Automatic replies are not being sent while user is on vacation
solution: Turn on automatic replies in Outlook settings, confirm the date range is correct, and check that external replies are enabled if outside senders should get a response.

description: VPN fails to connect when working from home
solution: Check the home internet, restart the VPN client, update it to the latest version, verify credentials and MFA, and try another network. Some routers block VPN ports, so test with a mobile hotspot.

description: VPN connects but internal websites and file shares do not open
solution: Disconnect and reconnect, flush DNS with ipconfig /flushdns, check that the user belongs to the VPN access group, and confirm split tunneling routes are applied.

description: VPN disconnects every few minutes
solution: Switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection if possible, turn off power saving on the network adapter, update the VPN client, and try the TCP connection mode.

description: VPN shows a certificate error on login
solution: The device certificate has probably expired. Renew it through device management or re-enroll the laptop, then reconnect.

description: User forgot how to set up the VPN on a new laptop
solution: Install the corporate VPN client from Software Center, sign in with the work account, approve MFA, and select the company profile.

description: Laptop cannot connect to the corporate WiFi
solution: Forget the network and reconnect with current credentials, check that the password has not expired, confirm the device certificate is valid, and restart the WiFi adapter.

description: Connected to WiFi but there is no internet access
solution: Run ipconfig /release and ipconfig /renew, flush DNS, restart the adapter, and check whether a captive portal or guest login page needs to be completed.

description: WiFi is very slow in the conference room
solution: Move closer to the access point, connect to the 5 GHz network, and report the room location and time to the network team so they can check access point load.

description: Visitor needs internet access in the office
solution: Create a guest voucher in the wireless portal with a 24 hour expiry and share the credentials with the visitor.

description: Desktop connected by cable has no internet
solution: Check the cable and wall port, try a different patch cable, run ipconfig /release and /renew, test another port, and escalate to the network team to check the switch port.

description: Internet is slow at one desk while others are fine
solution: Run a speed test, look for large downloads or cloud backups running, try a wired connection, restart the network adapter, and escalate if the issue is limited to that port.

description: Websites cannot be found but the internet works
solution: Run ipconfig /flushdns, set DNS back to automatic so the corporate DNS servers are used, and test with nslookup.

description: Windows shows an IP address conflict warning
solution: Release and renew the IP address, make sure the adapter uses DHCP, and ask the network team to find the duplicate static assignment.

description: Mapped network drive shows a red X and is disconnected
solution: Connect to the VPN if off site, remap the drive using the \\server\share path, confirm permissions, and run gpupdate /force to reapply drive mappings.

description: User gets access denied on a shared folder
solution: Ask the folder owner or manager to approve access, add the user to the correct Active Directory group, and have them sign out and in so the new group applies.

description: Cannot connect to a work PC with Remote Desktop
solution: Confirm the VPN is connected, the target PC is powered on and awake, Remote Desktop is enabled, and the user is in the Remote Desktop Users group. Check the firewall allows port 3389.

description: Printer shows as offline even though it is turned on
solution: Check the printer network connection and power, set it to online in printer properties, restart the Print Spooler service, and remove and re-add the printer if needed.

description: Print jobs are stuck in the queue and nothing prints
solution: Stop the Print Spooler service, delete the files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, and start the service again. Then resend the print job.

description: User cannot find the network printer on their laptop
solution: Add the printer using the print server path such as \\printserver\name, install the correct driver, and check the laptop is on the office network or VPN.

description: Printouts have streaks or are faded
solution: Replace the toner cartridge, run the printer cleaning cycle, and check the drum unit. Call the vendor if streaks continue after a new cartridge.

description: Printer keeps jamming paper
solution: Clear the jam carefully following the printer panel instructions, check the paper is not damp or the wrong type, realign the tray guides, and request a service visit if it happens repeatedly.

description: Scan to email from the office printer is not working
solution: Verify the SMTP settings and sender address on the printer, confirm the mailbox is not over quota, and check the printer can reach the mail server.

description: Printer stopped working after a Windows update
solution: Download and install the latest driver from the manufacturer, remove the old printer, add it again, and uninstall the problematic update if the issue continues.

description: User needs access to the color printer on another floor
solution: Get manager approval, add the user to the printer security group, and add the printer to their laptop through the print server.

description: Laptop does not power on at all
solution: Check the charger and outlet, hold the power button for 30 seconds to drain residual charge, try a different power adapter, and arrange a hardware replacement if it still does not start.

description: Laptop gets very hot and the fan is loud
solution: Clean the vents, use it on a hard flat surface, check Task Manager for high CPU processes, update BIOS and drivers, and send it to the hardware team for a thermal paste check.

description: Laptop battery only lasts an hour
solution: Run powercfg /batteryreport to check battery health, lower screen brightness, close background apps, and replace the battery if health is below 60 percent.

description: Laptop screen flickers or shows lines
solution: Update the graphics driver, change the refresh rate, test with an external monitor, and arrange a repair if the external monitor looks fine.

description: Laptop screen is cracked
solution: Log a damage report, give the user a loaner laptop, back up their data if possible, and order a screen replacement.

description: External monitor shows no signal
solution: Check the cable at both ends, select the correct input on the monitor, press Windows key + P to extend or duplicate, update graphics drivers, and try another port.

description: Second monitor is not detected by the laptop
solution: Open Display settings and click Detect, update the dock firmware and graphics driver, reseat the cable, and test with a different cable.

description: Some keyboard keys are not working
solution: Clean under the keys, test with an external keyboard, check for spills, and replace the keyboard if the keys remain unresponsive.

description: Keyboard types wrong characters such as quotes and symbols
solution: Press Windows key + Space to switch input language, and remove any extra keyboard layouts under Time and Language settings.

description: Wireless mouse is laggy or stops moving
solution: Replace the battery, reconnect the USB receiver in a closer port, re-pair the mouse, and keep it away from other wireless devices.

description: Docking station does not charge or detect monitors
solution: Update the dock firmware and laptop BIOS, reseat the cable, try another USB-C port, and use the manufacturer's certified power adapter.

description: USB device is not recognized by the computer
solution: Try another port, reinstall the driver from Device Manager, and turn off USB selective suspend in power options.

description: Webcam is not detected in Teams meetings
solution: Check camera privacy settings in Windows, select the correct camera in the app, update the driver, and close other apps that may be using the camera.

description: No audio comes from the laptop speakers
solution: Check the selected output device, unmute the volume, update the audio driver, and restart the Windows Audio service.

description: Microphone does not work during online meetings
solution: Allow microphone access in privacy settings, choose the correct input device in the meeting app, and test the mic in Sound settings.

description: Bluetooth headphones or mouse will not pair
solution: Remove the device from Bluetooth settings, turn Bluetooth off and on, put the device in pairing mode, and update the Bluetooth driver.

description: Computer shows a blue screen and restarts
solution: Note the stop code, update drivers, run sfc /scannow and DISM, run the Windows Memory Diagnostic, and uninstall any recent update or driver that started the problem.

description: Computer is very slow and takes minutes to start
solution: Check Task Manager for heavy processes, disable unneeded startup apps, free disk space, install pending updates, scan for malware, and consider an SSD or more RAM.

description: Computer freezes randomly and needs a restart
solution: Check disk health, update drivers and BIOS, monitor temperature, run a memory test, and reimage the device if software corruption is found.

description: Laptop says disk is almost full
solution: Run Disk Cleanup and Storage Sense, move files to OneDrive, uninstall unused apps, and empty the Recycle Bin.

description: Windows will not start and loops on the recovery screen
solution: Run Startup Repair, boot in Safe Mode, try a system restore point, and back up data before reimaging the device if repair fails.

description: Laptop asks for a BitLocker recovery key at startup
solution: Verify the user's identity and retrieve the recovery key from the admin portal. The prompt often appears after a BIOS, hardware, or firmware change.

description: Fingerprint or face sign-in stopped working
solution: Remove and set up Windows Hello again, update the biometric driver, and use the PIN as a fallback meanwhile.

description: Laptop does not wake up from sleep
solution: Adjust power settings, turn off Fast Startup, update chipset and graphics drivers, and hold the power button to force a restart.

description: Windows shows an activation warning
solution: Connect to the corporate network or VPN so the device reaches the KMS server, then run slmgr /ato. Contact IT if the license key needs to be reassigned.

description: Laptop touchscreen is not responding
solution: Restart the device, update the touch driver, disable and re-enable the HID-compliant touch screen in Device Manager, and clean the screen.

description: Employee needs a second monitor or headset
solution: Submit an equipment request with manager approval and issue the item from stock. Record the asset tag against the user.

description: Employee needs new software installed
solution: Submit a request with business justification and manager approval, then deploy the application through Software Center or Intune.

description: User cannot install an application because admin rights are required
solution: Use the approved app in Software Center, or request temporary elevation through the approval process. Permanent local admin rights should not be granted.

description: Adobe application says the license has expired
solution: Reassign the Adobe license to the user in the admin console, then have them sign out and back in to the app.

description: Microsoft Office says product activation failed
solution: Sign in with the work account, check the license is assigned in the admin center, sign out of extra devices if the limit is reached, and repair Office.

description: Application crashes as soon as it launches
solution: Update the application, run a repair, clear its cache, review Event Viewer for the error, and reinstall if the crash continues.

description: Excel is not responding when opening a large spreadsheet
solution: Open in safe mode, disable add-ins, set calculation to manual, and save the file in binary xlsb format to reduce size.

description: Excel file is corrupted and will not open
solution: Use Open and Repair from the Open dialog, recover from OneDrive version history, or restore an earlier copy from backup.

description: Word closed and the unsaved document is lost
solution: Reopen Word and check the Document Recovery pane, look in the AutoRecover folder, and check OneDrive version history.

description: PDF files will not open
solution: Update the PDF reader, set it as the default app, and download the file again in case it was corrupted.

description: Web pages load slowly or not at all in Chrome or Edge
solution: Clear cache and cookies, disable extensions, update the browser, and reset the browser settings if needed.

description: Browser shows a certificate warning for a website
solution: Check the computer date and time, test on another network, and do not bypass the warning. Report it to IT if the site is an internal system.

description: Windows update is stuck or keeps failing
solution: Run the Windows Update troubleshooter, restart the device, clear the SoftwareDistribution folder, and install the failed update manually if needed.

description: Antivirus blocks a legitimate business application
solution: Submit an exclusion request to the security team with the application name, path, and business reason. Do not disable antivirus.

description: Business application is slow only for one user
solution: Clear the application cache, check network latency, test another browser or device, and compare with other users to see whether the issue is user specific.

description: Teams opens to a blank white screen
solution: Fully quit Teams, clear the Teams cache folder, sign out and back in, update the app, or reinstall it.

description: Teams notifications are not showing
solution: Check notification settings in Teams and Windows, turn off Focus Assist, and make sure the presence status is not set to Do Not Disturb.

description: User cannot join a Teams meeting from the link
solution: Join through the web browser instead, check meeting permissions and lobby settings, update Teams, and allow camera and microphone access.

description: Screen sharing does not work in online meetings
solution: Grant screen recording permission on macOS, share a specific window instead of the whole screen, and restart the meeting app.

description: Zoom audio has echo during meetings
solution: Use a headset, mute when not speaking, and make sure only one device is joined to the same meeting.

description: User cannot sign in to the company Slack workspace
solution: Use the SSO login option with the work email, confirm the invitation was accepted, and check the workspace URL.

description: OneDrive files are not syncing
solution: Check the user is signed in, resume sync if paused, free up disk space, check for long file paths or invalid characters, and reset OneDrive with onedrive.exe /reset.

description: OneDrive shows a red X on some files
solution: Close any file that is open, fix name conflicts and unsupported characters, then unlink and relink the OneDrive account if the error remains.

description: User cannot open a SharePoint site
solution: Request access from the site owner, check the user is signed in with the work account, and verify conditional access does not block the device.

description: User accidentally deleted an important file
solution: Check the Recycle Bin and the second-stage Recycle Bin, use version history, or restore the OneDrive within 30 days. For network shares, request a restore from backup.

description: External guest cannot open a shared file link
solution: Check the external sharing policy for the site, send the link to Specific People, and invite the guest as a guest user if required.

description: Laptop will not display on the conference room screen
solution: Check the HDMI or USB-C cable and input source, press Windows key + P, and reconnect wireless casting after restarting the room device.

description: Computer shows pop-ups and behaves strangely
solution: Disconnect from the network, do not enter any information, run a full antivirus scan, notify the security team, and reimage the device if it persists.

description: Files are encrypted and a ransom note appears on screen
solution: Disconnect the device from the network immediately, do not pay, contact the security incident team, and restore files from clean backups after the device is cleaned.

description: Laptop was lost or stolen
solution: Report it right away to IT security and the police, lock or wipe the device through device management, disable the account, and reset the user's passwords.

description: User received an alert about an unusual sign-in
solution: Reset the password, revoke all sessions, verify MFA methods, and review sign-in logs for other suspicious activity.

description: User cannot use a USB flash drive
solution: USB storage is blocked by security policy. Use OneDrive or SharePoint for file transfer, or request an exception with manager and security approval.

description: User shared a confidential file with the wrong person
solution: Remove the sharing link or permission immediately, tell the security or data protection team, and record what was shared and with whom.

description: Internal website shows an expired certificate
solution: Renew the certificate on the server, install it, restart the web service, and confirm clients trust the certificate chain.

description: Employee is unsure whether an attachment is safe
solution: Do not open it. Forward it to the security team or use the Report button so it can be checked in a sandbox.

description: User wants to set up work email on their phone
solution: Install Outlook mobile, sign in with the work account, and accept the device management enrollment when prompted.

description: Company Portal enrollment fails on a mobile phone
solution: Update the Company Portal app and phone OS, remove any old management profile, restart the phone, and try enrolling again.

description: Company mobile phone was lost
solution: Remote lock or wipe the phone through device management, ask the carrier to suspend the SIM, and report the loss to IT security.

description: Cannot sign in to the AWS or Azure console
solution: Confirm MFA works, check the user is in the correct SSO group or IAM role, and ask the cloud team to verify permissions.

description: Git push fails with permission denied
solution: Check the SSH key or personal access token has not expired, confirm the user has write access to the repository, and re-authenticate the Git client.

description: User cannot see a Jira or Confluence project
solution: Ask the project admin to add the user to the correct project role, and confirm the user is signed in with the work account.

description: Cannot connect to the database from a laptop
solution: Confirm the VPN is connected, credentials are correct, and the laptop IP is on the firewall allow list. Request access from the database team if it is a new user.

description: User cannot log in to the ERP or finance system
solution: Check the account is active in the application, confirm the role is assigned, reset the application password, and ask the system owner for access if needed.

description: Desk phone has no dial tone
solution: Check the network cable and PoE port, restart the phone, and re-register it with the phone system.

description: User cannot access voicemail
solution: Reset the voicemail PIN, confirm the mailbox is active, and dial the voicemail access number from the desk phone.

description: Voice calls sound choppy or drop
solution: Use a wired connection, close bandwidth-heavy apps, use a headset, and ask the network team to check QoS settings.

description: Company intranet page is not loading
solution: Connect to the VPN if off site, clear the browser cache, and check the status page for a known outage before escalating.

description: User needs a file restored from backup
solution: Open a request with the file path and the date it was last good. The team restores it from the nightly backup within one business day.

description: Computer clock is wrong and causes sign-in and certificate errors
solution: Turn on automatic time and time zone, sync with the time server using w32tm /resync, and check the CMOS battery on older desktops.

description: Barcode scanner is not reading codes
solution: Reconnect the USB cable or Bluetooth pairing, scan the configuration barcode for the correct mode, clean the scanner window, and replace it if it still fails.

description: Employee starting remote work needs home setup help
solution: Confirm laptop, VPN, MFA, and headset are ready, share the remote work guide, and schedule a test connection with the helpdesk.
